name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I'm applying for the Lifecycle Marketing Coordinator role. Most of what I build is the work this role executes: automated journeys that get someone booked, remind them, recover them when they miss, and bring them back when they go quiet. In my own practice I built a 20+ workflow system in GoHighLevel that does exactly that, along with the segmented email sequences, landing pages, and forms behind it.

I also handle the detail that keeps a program trustworthy. I manage segmentation and data hygiene, validate every import, edit HTML and CSS directly, test before anything goes live, and document each workflow so someone else can pick it up. I report in GA4, Excel, and SQL, and I'm used to working with the people who own the data rather than around them.

The mission matters to me personally. I've spent years as a patient navigating the healthcare system myself, and I know how much a well-timed, human message can change whether someone keeps showing up for care. I have more experience than the title suggests, and I want to put it toward this. I'd welcome a conversation.
